text:
Morgan: Quick pulse — we have a 20-min micro-webinar next Thu 10am PT. Need X + LinkedIn thread schedule, short copy variants, and 1 hero image + 2 carousel images. Can we lock cadence?

Lee: Got it. Do we want a sticky post on X the morning of and threads over the week?

Morgan: Yes, sticky on morning of (2 posts: announcement + registration CTA), then 3 lead-up threads across Tues/Wed/Thu. Also post-run follow-up with clip + TL;DR.

Sara: I'll draft short copy options. Prefer A/B test subject lines on X: "Reduce LLM latency 3x" vs "Cut inference cost in half" — thoughts?

Devon: Sending hero + two carousel options by EOD. Using new benchmark graph. Want the graph to highlight latency/cost tradeoff.

Jamal: For inbound routing — route webinar signups to SDR queue #web-inbound, tag by company size. Also need UTM params. Suggest `?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=microwebinar_may`.

Morgan: Perfect. Lee, can you map out the posting times? Keep windows: 9am PT, 1pm PT, 4pm PT.

Lee: Draft schedule:
```
Tue 9am PT — Thread 1 (intro + benchmark stat)
Wed 1pm PT — Thread 2 (customer quote + CTA)
Thu 9am PT — Sticky announcement + reg link
Thu 4pm PT — Live reminder + clip post
Fri 9am PT — Follow-up recap + recording link
```
I'll queue these in Buffer and share calendar invites.

Sara: Copy variants done. Pasting two X headlines:
- "Reduce inference latency with Redwood — demo + benchmarks"
- "How we cut tokens per second cost by 45% — live register"

Devon: Uploaded assets: `hero_v3.png`, `carousel_a.zip`. Link: https://drive.redwood/marketing/microweb

LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled: webinar in 72 hours — registration page: https://redwood.ai/webinars/micro-inference

Morgan: Awesome. Final asks: Lee — schedule; Sara — finalize one long-form LinkedIn post; Devon — export final hero in 1200x675; Jamal — confirm SDR queue mapping and UTM live. Let's sync tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
